faq.title: Common Questions
faq.q1: How long does a project take?
faq.a1: Timeline depends on scope. Simple websites can take 1–2 weeks, while web apps, AI systems, and multi-platform products typically take 6–12 weeks.
faq.q2: Can you work with our existing codebase?
faq.a2: Yes. We can continue, improve, or refactor an existing codebase after a technical assessment.
faq.a3: You do, subject to the project agreement. We don't create unnecessary vendor dependencies.
faq.a4: Projects are split into agreed milestones so scope, progress, and payments stay clear.
faq.q5: Are third-party AI or cloud costs included?
faq.a5: Usage costs from third-party services such as LLM APIs, cloud infrastructure, or external platforms are normally separate from development fees.
faq.q6: What if my project doesn't fit any of these categories?
faq.a6: Most projects are a combination of services. Just tell us what you need during the scoping call and we'll put together a custom proposal with a clear breakdown.
